_: Which raw photo plays which role. Every key under 'products' MUST point at a file whose name starts with that product's id (tools/normalize-images.py refuses otherwise). That is the guard against the hybrid-shows-a-putter bug in the v3 sheets.
_bag: lucky-carver-gold-hero.webp is NOT used: the irons around the gold wedge in that bag are another brand's, with the model name readable.
_pack: Pack shot = the one studio frame per product used on every card. Chosen for the same family of angle: head low in frame, shaft rising out of the top. The raw angles still differ (the reshoot fixes that); the normaliser fixes size, position and ground.
apparel: every polo-* and hat-* product uses its Shopify main image as the pack shot
